283105290.description:
Mineral Specimen Lot - 2 Pieces
Bismuth Hopper Crystal & Smoky Quartz
This mineral lot features an iridescent bismuth hopper crystal alongside a natural smoky quartz specimen. The bismuth displays intricate stair-step geometric hopper formations with rainbow oxidation hues of gold, violet, and green. The rough smoky quartz exhibits translucent tea-brown color, glassy luster, and conchoidal fractures, offering a striking visual contrast.
Items Included:
Bismuth Hopper Crystal: Lab-grown geometric crystal with vibrant rainbow iridescence.
Smoky Quartz Specimen: Raw brown quartz stone with natural facets and inclusions.
Two-piece white cardboard storage box.
Condition:
Both specimens are in good collector condition. The bismuth crystal features crisp step-edges and bright luster. The smoky quartz shows natural rough texture and internal fractures typical of raw stones. The cardboard box shows minor cosmetic shelf wear.
